description: In all three CRL verification paths (cert-issuer, anchor, delta), the cryptographic signature is verified before the thisUpdate/nextUpdate window check. An expired CRL performs a full RSA/EC verification that could be short-circuited by a cheap timestamp comparison. Move validity-window checks before verifier.verify_signature() calls. File: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs lines 220-243, 364-382, 494-522.
title: crl: signature verified before validity window check
